verification_audit.method: Compared current Xenoverse 2-specific skill documentation with independent Xenoverse 2 references and existing repository research coverage.

records.name: Super Mad Dance
records.character_source: Gogeta (Super Saiyan) / Gogeta (Super Saiyan 4) customizable partner / SSGSS Gogeta / Gogeta (DB Super)
records.skill_description: A teleporting Strike Super that begins with a kick and can continue into additional teleporting kicks; directional input changes the follow-up pattern.
records.mechanics_notes: The Xenoverse 2 reference describes a three-hit sequence for the standard version, with additional follow-up attacks possible depending on transformation and directional input. The move launches the opponent, teleports along the opponent's path, and changes the final attacks based on input direction. Exact frame and damage values are not promoted to canonical numeric data.
records.acquisition_notes: The canonical Xenoverse 2 route is the Skill Shop. Independent references also identify Super Mad Dance as one of Gogeta's Super Skills available through the shop.
records.pve_notes: Skill Shop acquisition; no Parallel Quest or Ultimate Finish requirement established.
records.pvp_notes: Fast Strike Super with teleporting follow-ups and directional pattern selection; detailed frame and matchup behavior remains version-sensitive.
